title: Concord Road Elementary records 0 American Indian or Alaska Native students enrolled for 2025-26
text:
Concord Road Elementary School reported no enrollment of American Indian or Alaska Native students for the 2025-26 school year—a 100% decrease compared with the prior year—according to the New York State Education Department .
During 2025-26, the school enrolled a total of 780 students. American Indian or Alaska Native students accounted for 0%, making them the least represented ethnic group at the school.
The campus is part of the Ardsley Union Free School District, which is based in Ardsley.
Out of the three district schools, Ardsley Middle School reported the largest number of American Indian or Alaska Native students, with two enrolled at that time.
World Population Review analysis ranked New York’s public school system as second overall in the country , while placing it 31st for K-12 performance.
